race.comment: SICILIAN PRINCESS (12) raced near the speed and loomed up to win but just found a couple marginally better last start over 1300m at this track. Failed over 1600m last prep but it was at Listed level. Very fit after two runs back and this looks a nice race for her. BARGAIN BOY (4) settled near the tail then wound up nicely to finish fourth in a similar race here last time out. Won't spend a penny from the inside alley and is going to be tough to hold out when presented. The form around ANAHORISH (8) is white-hot, coming through some of the strongest form references you've seen. Has a powerful turn of foot on her day and Callow fits her well. Watch for her rounding them up late. ROUSING REFRAIN (9) was much better fourth-up when missing by a long neck here. At his top now and gets Stubby from a handy middle draw. Not hopeless.
